summary: POET Technologies filed a Form 6-K with an attached press release announcing participation in the CIOE 2026 trade show in Shenzhen and a speaking slot at the IFOC conference. No financial terms, transactions, or strategic events are disclosed. The filing is a routine corporate communications update regarding marketing and conference activities, with no elements of an acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, or other special situation. The registrant is the filer of this routine current report, and no special-situations categorization applies.
